Completed only the assigned reviser stage. The one frozen native Goal passed the binding guard; its activation and completion responses are saved at [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json).

The complete proposal is [final.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/reviser/final.md), with its [source map](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/reviser/source-map.json) and [source index](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/reviser/sources/index.md). It includes dispositions for all five critic findings and an explicit fidelity matrix for web, offline, and print/PDF outputs. The H5P issue remains open, with a contributor’s non-reproduction noted and the affected installed version still unknown ([upstream issue](https://github.com/h5p/h5p-multi-choice/issues/186)).

Citation links and required files were checked. Application, package, DOCX, PDF, and accessibility validations remain proposed; none were run.
